name: Kids 6-Panel Cap
tagline: Soft structured crown, 52–55 cm band, strap kids can adjust themselves.
blurb: Structured kids cap with a soft crown, a 52–55 cm band and a no-pinch strap.
intro: Kids outgrow caps faster than they wear them out, so this one is built around the two things that matter: a band that starts at 52 cm and a crown that does not fight the logo. Light buckram holds the front panel flat, and the rest stays soft enough to fold into a backpack.

The strap is a plastic snap with a tuck-in tail, sized so a seven-year-old can tighten it without help. There are no detachable charms, clips or pins anywhere on the cap. Decoration is flat embroidery or a small woven patch, and the front panel takes a mark up to 7 cm wide.

features.title: Soft structured crown
features.text: Light buckram keeps the front panel flat for embroidery without making the cap stiff.

features.title: No small parts
features.text: Sewn-on button, stitched eyelets and no detachable charms, so there is nothing to pull off.

features.title: Adjustable 52–55 cm
features.text: Plastic snap with a tuck-in tail; the band also fits most four- to eight-year-olds.

features.title: Adult-grade twill build
features.text: The same 260 gsm cotton twill and four-row visor stitching we use on adult caps.

faqs.q: What ages does the 52–55 cm band fit?
faqs.a: About four to eight years. The snap takes up 3 cm, so the band closes to 52 cm without the crown dropping over the ears.

faqs.q: Are there any small parts?
faqs.a: No. The top button is sewn through, the eyelets are stitched, and there is no charm, clip or pin anywhere on the cap.

faqs.q: Can I split a 50 pc order between sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. The kids band and the toddler band can be mixed in one 50 pc colorway at no extra cost.

name: Kids Trucker Cap
tagline: Foam front, mesh back, 50–54 cm band — the cheapest cap to print.
blurb: Foam-front kids trucker with a mesh back and a 50–54 cm strap. Big logo, low cost.
intro: A kids trucker is the cheapest way to put a large logo on a small head. The foam front is flat, so a 10 cm print or patch sits square with no curve distortion, and the mesh back keeps a running, sweaty kid noticeably cooler than cotton.

Sizing runs 50–54 cm on a plastic snap, which covers about three to six years. The front takes screen print, flat embroidery or a woven patch; the mesh back is left plain because embroidery on mesh puckers. Minimum is 50 pcs per colorway, mixed sizes allowed.

features.text: Takes a 10 cm wide print or patch with no curvature distortion.

features.title: Mesh back vents air
features.text: Poly mesh moves air, which matters for a cap worn all summer.

features.title: No small parts
features.text: Snap closure, sewn-on button, no detachable badge or charm.

features.title: Cheapest decoration we run
features.text: Screen print on foam is the lowest-cost method per unit.

faqs.q: What size head does 50–54 cm fit?
faqs.a: Roughly three to six years. The snap closes to 50 cm and opens to 54 cm, and a toddler band at 46–48 cm is available in the same colorway.

faqs.q: Can the mesh back be embroidered?
faqs.a: No. Embroidery puckers on open mesh, so keep decoration on the foam front or use a woven patch.

faqs.q: Are there small parts on this cap?
faqs.a: None that detach. The snap and the sewn-on top button are the only hardware.

name: Kids Cotton Bucket Hat
tagline: 5.5 cm brim, 50–54 cm band, neck cord — a bucket hat that stays on.
blurb: Cotton bucket hat with a neck cord and a 5.5 cm brim for playground sun.
intro: A bucket hat is the practical answer for kids who will not keep a cap on: the brim shades the ears and the neck cord keeps it attached when they run. This one is 100% cotton twill with a 5.5 cm brim, a 50–54 cm band and a soft crown that packs flat.

The cord is a flat woven tape with a plastic toggle, long enough to sit under a collar and short enough that it will not catch on play equipment. Child-safe build: no small detachable parts, no wire in the brim, and the band is a single stitched loop rather than an adjustable strap.

features.title: Brim shades ears
features.text: 5.5 cm brim angles down to cover the ears and the back of the neck.

features.title: Cord keeps it on

features.title: No small parts
features.text: No charm, clip or detachable badge; the cord is stitched into the band.

features.title: Folds into a bag
features.text: Soft cotton crown packs down, with no buckram to crack.

faqs.q: Does the neck cord come off?
faqs.a: No. It is stitched into the band at both ends and cannot be removed, which is deliberate on a kids hat.

faqs.q: Is the brim stiff?
faqs.a: No wire and no plastic insert. It is a soft downturned brim that folds when the hat is packed.

faqs.q: Can it be washed?
faqs.a: Hand wash cold and air dry. A machine wash flattens the brim and softens the crown.

name: Kids Reversible Bucket Hat
tagline: Two prints in one hat, 52–56 cm, packable — flip it and it is a new cap.
blurb: Reversible bucket hat: two prints, one 52–56 cm band, packs into a pocket.
intro: Two hats in one bag: a printed cotton bucket with a second print on the inside, joined at the brim so it can be turned inside out and worn the other way. Useful for travel, camp and any parent who has watched a child refuse the hat they picked.

The band is 52–56 cm with a soft elastic back, so it fits roughly six to eleven years. Both prints are reactive-printed, which holds color through a summer of pool water, and the whole hat weighs about 55 g. No small parts: no drawstring toggle, no charm, no detachable badge.

faqs.q: How does a reversible hat work?
faqs.a: The two prints are joined at the brim seam. You turn the hat inside out through the open crown and the second print becomes the outside.

faqs.q: Will the prints fade?
faqs.a: Reactive printing dyes the fiber rather than coating it, so pool water and sun fade it slowly. Expect some softening after a full summer.

faqs.q: What ages fit 52–56 cm?
faqs.a: About six to eleven years. The elastic back takes up 4 cm and there is no strap to adjust.

name: Baby Sun Hat with Chin Strap
tagline: 44–48 cm, 6 cm brim, tie chin strap and UPF 50+ cotton — first-summer hat.
blurb: Baby sun hat with a wide 6 cm brim, tie chin strap and UPF 50+ fabric.
intro: For a baby too young for a cap, the sun hat does the work: a 6 cm brim that covers the face and the back of the neck, a 44–48 cm band and a chin strap that keeps it on in a stroller or a carrier.

The fabric is a UPF 50+ cotton poplin: the rating sits in the weave and the finish, not in a topical coating, so it does not wash off. Safety details matter more here than anywhere else: the strap ties, the toggle releases under a firm pull, the brim is soft with no wire, and there are no small parts on the hat at all.

faqs.q: Is UPF 50+ a coating?
faqs.a: No. It is a property of the cotton poplin weave and the finish, so it does not wash off the way a topical treatment does.

faqs.q: How does the chin strap release?
faqs.a: The strap ties, and the plastic toggle gives way under a firm pull so the loop cannot tighten around the neck.

faqs.q: What age is 44–48 cm?
faqs.a: About 3 to 18 months. Measure the head just above the ears; the band is fixed and should not need room to grow.

name: Baby Brim Sun Hat
tagline: 42–46 cm, soft brim and hook-and-loop strap — the newborn sun hat.
blurb: Smallest sun hat we make: 42–46 cm band, soft brim, hook-and-loop strap.
intro: This is the newborn size: a 42–46 cm band, a soft brim and a hook-and-loop strap instead of a tie, because a strap a parent can open one-handed is the difference between the hat staying on and ending up in the stroller basket at all, which is where most baby hats finish.

The brim is a single layer of cotton with a soft interlining, no wire and no plastic insert, so it folds when a baby sleeps against a shoulder. The band is a fixed loop with no adult-size adjuster to leave slack, and there are no small parts: no button on top, no charm, no detachable badge.

faqs.q: What age is the 42–46 cm band?
faqs.a: Newborn to about nine months. It is a fixed loop, so measure before ordering rather than guessing.

faqs.q: Why hook-and-loop instead of a tie?
faqs.a: It opens one-handed while you are holding the baby, and it does not come undone in a stroller.

faqs.q: Does the brim hold its shape?
faqs.a: It is soft interlined cotton with no wire. It folds against a shoulder and presses back out.
